2292-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

792-4279-4699--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-4699--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2645-3181-3257-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3181-3257-3430.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

573-1719-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
573-1719-2645-3430.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

640-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
640-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Dross Harvester triggers three times, causing you to gain 2 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

225-864-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-864-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-864-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Eternal Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1669-3234-3293-3899.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-3899.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-3899.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

6734-7841-8089.description:
Activate Shadowcloak Vampire by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3010-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-3043-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-7297.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2921-3490-5445-7426.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
2921-3490-5445-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2921-3490-5445-7426.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another artifact or creature.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

679-5636-6282.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-5636-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

2281-4050-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2173-4740-5220-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
2173-4740-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying X life, where X is the creature's mana value.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.
2173-4740-5220-6797.notes: Your starting life total will need to be at least a certain number depending on the mana value of the creature you are sacrificing to perform this combo. This list shows the minimum life total you would need to have, from mana value 1 (left) to 10 (right): 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, 22, 29, 37, 46, 56. You can also cast spells to reduce the needed life to start.

224-907-3314-3430-4826.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using three in any combination of {G} and/or {W}, and have the mana to cast it.
224-907-3314-3430-4826.description:
Cast the creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from your hand to the battlefield.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Chulane.
Resolve the creature spell cast in step 1.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning the creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1491-3129-4474-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3591-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have a card in hand.
392-3591-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
392-3591-5796-6282.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
Resolve all Harnfel abilities.

955-2105-3204-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
955-2105-3204-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

781-6285.notablePrerequisites: You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
781-6285.description:
Cast Traumatize by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing a player to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each player to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus causing the player targeted by Traumatize to mill the rest of their library.
781-6285.notes: The opponent will have one card remaining if their deck size was odd to start the combo. If it was even, their library will be empty.

1606-5137-5963.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1606-5137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

457-4885-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-4885-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

1069-1232-4068-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-4068-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1494-2034-2527-3784-4275.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding an amount of {C} equal to Vhal's toughness that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Haunted One triggers, causing Humans and Wizards you control to get +2/+0 and to gain undying until end of turn.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sage of Hours, adding {C}{C}.
When Sage of Hours dies, its undying ability and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Sage of Hours trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Humans and Wizards.
Repeat.

774-1671-2653.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

586-944-2511-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

851-2781-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
851-2781-5917.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Felidar Guardian that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

1902-3869-4067.notablePrerequisites: Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness. There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
1902-3869-4067.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.

2793-2981-5483.description:
During your end step, activate Megatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Esoteric Duplicator triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus at the beginning of your next end step.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Esoteric Duplicator triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Repeat.

1938-1987-2781.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Glorious Protector and Felidar Guardian.
When Glorious Protector and Felidar Guardian enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian and any number of other non-Angel creatures you control until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves and re-enters the battlefield, returning Felidar Guardian to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2386-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that does not have Pattern of Rebirth attached to it.
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2386-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pattern of Rebirth attached to any creature you control except the creature that has the nontoken Pattern of Rebirth attached to it, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that has the token copy of Pattern of Rebirth attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Pattern of Rebirth triggers, causing you to search your library for a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

813-1000-1195-4050.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{U}, plus an additional {1} available if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
813-1000-1195-4050.description:
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Scholar of the Ages.
Activate Homarid Spawning Bed by paying {1}{U}{U} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, creating seven token copies of Scholar of the Ages.
Each of the newly created Scholar of the Ages tokens triggers, returning Mystic Reflection and up to thirteen other instant and/or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Scholar of the Ages tokens, adding {3}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

890-1978-2410-3852.notablePrerequisites: Myr Galvanizer, Palladium Myr and Leaden Myr do not have summoning sickness.
890-1978-2410-3852.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Leaden Myr by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.

396-1847-2608-4050.description:
Activate The Golden Throne by tapping it and sacrificing Derevi, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Choose to return Derevi to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting Derevi onto the battlefield from the command zone.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Blessed Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping The Golden Throne.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2387-2457-2850-3129-5295.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Whenever the Insects enter the battlefield, Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each of them.
Activate the Ants by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

48-2232-2246-4848.notablePrerequisites: Bard Class is at least level two.
48-2232-2246-4848.description:
Activate Domri's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R/G}.
Cast Wrenn and Six by paying {0}.
Wrenn and Six enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Domri from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Wrenn and Six's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Domri by paying {1}.
Domri enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Wrenn and Six from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1518-1987-3227-4792.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-3227-4792.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Scrivener, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
